llm_response.reason: While altswitch.io exhibits some characteristics common in risky crypto projects—such as speculative language, hyped promotional tactics, celebrity name-dropping, and profit/yield promises—it also publicly lists its team, cites audit attempts, and is discussed in recognized crypto communities without widespread scam accusations or reports of lost funds.
